body: At this rate, I have no clue how to make clangd-tidy happy.
Could you rebase this one more time, to re-trigger artifact generation? I would like to review this.

> Could you rebase this one more time, to re-trigger artifact generation? I would like to review this.

Done.

Testing should be possible with `gamemoded -s`. It should show inactive before running a project, active while running, and inactive again after closing.

Rebased to keep up to date with `master`.

Since the thirdparty implementation is a single header that already includes the license, I opted to move it to the `misc/` directory.

Otherwise, the implementation is pretty much the same.

Since we are adding this setting, it would make sense to use it for macOS/iOS game mode as well (it was auto-detected based on app category, but macOS/iOS 26+ have a dedicated setting to enable it, and it's likely will be necessary to use it in the future OS versions in any case).

One issue is that, while the Linux implementation is a project setting, it would only be applied on export for macOS/iOS.

While I do agree the setting should apply to those, I think it would increase the intended scope out of the Linux platform. Moreover, I don't have an Apple device to test it. Maybe it should be a separate PR?

> One issue is that, while the Linux implementation is a project setting, it would only be applied on export for macOS/iOS.

I think this is already true for some existing settings.

> I don't have an Apple device to test it. Maybe it should be a separate PR?

It not necessarily should be in the same PR. I'll make a separate PR and re-test it once this one is merged.
